summary: FlixIT iteration 2 tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (health, media-assets movie+tv+invalid, 7 list endpoints have all 6 media asset fields with majority non-null titled_backdrop_path, available-sections=30 templates, public sections, admin login+sections regression). Frontend: /browse renders correctly - all 6 nav testids present, footer 'FlixIT © 2026' with no TMDB, hero=100vh with play/info buttons at y=556 (upper 51%), home-rows starts at y=745 (69% of viewport). Hover overlays: FIRST card align='left' (x=46), MIDDLE align='center', LAST align='right' (right=1879<=1920), all with expanded-card, card-play/add/star/expand and 'Valutazione' text. Top10 slider shows top10-item-1..10, hover opens hover-overlay-top10-<id> with same expanded content. Infinite scroll grows rows from 7 → 35 with 'Crime · Film', 'Crime · Serie TV', 'Fantasy · Film', etc.; sentinel present. All 5 coming-soon routes (/serie-tv, /film, /archivio, /premium, /richiedi-un-titolo) show coming-soon-page with correct label and home-button returns to /browse. Unknown route shows 'Pagina non trovata'. Card-expand navigates to /browse/movie/<id> (renders), card-play to /watch/movie/<id>. Admin /admin/login with admin@admin.com/admin123 succeeds; /admin/sections lists 10 sections.
critical_code_review_comments: React 19 warning: 'Accessing element.ref was removed' printed multiple times on /browse — some component/library still reads element.ref as a property. Non-blocking but should be tracked (likely from MUI or slick internals).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_flixit_api.py uses BASE_URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and covers all iteration-2 features. Trending list items use fields 'tmdbId' and 'type' (not 'id'/'media_type'). Top10 slider does not use standard .slick-next class; custom arrow present but not needed since all 10 items already rendered in DOM. YouTube trailers cannot be tested in HeadlessChrome (per note). Infinite scroll settles around 35 rows after ~6 scrolls to bottom.
